conversation: My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season, and our village depends on us doing that. With 100 tons in the lake, we can take 50 tons total and leave 50 to double back to 100 next month. How about 10 tons each? That’s $10,000 apiece every month if we stick with it. I propose we all agree to that limit and review the catches together each month. John, what do you think?

I’m in, Luke—10 tons for me. My family’s livelihood has always depended on leaving enough for the next catch, and I want our village’s children to have that same chance. Let’s check the reported catches together each month and lower our limits if the lake ever starts below 100 tons. John, can you commit to 10 tons too?
